meta.name: MusicLinkd Enterprise Design Tokens
meta.note: v7.0: layered Gestalt (Pinterest, github.com/pinterest/gestalt, Apache-2.0) design tokens on top of the v6.0 4-token core. The v6.0 core (foundation.spacing/radius/opacity/motion/type, prefixed 1-4) is UNCHANGED — every consumer of --space-1..4, --radius-1..4, --duration-1..4, --type-1..4, --opacity-1..4 keeps rendering identically. Verified: MusicLinkd's spacing (4/8/16/32) and radius (8/16/32/pill) already land exactly on Gestalt's real space-100/200/400/800 and rounding-200/400/800/pill steps, so the new foundation.gestalt.* scale below is a superset, not a fork. Opacity, type (fluid clamps) and motion diverge from Gestalt's fixed-step originals by deliberate MusicLinkd choice (documented per-section below) and are kept as-is; Gestalt's real values are still provided in full under foundation.gestalt for new work. v8.0 (2026-08-16): fixed component.button.primary.background, which still pointed at pink after the black-primary correction shipped in the two real CSS files — tokens.json had drifted from the code it's supposed to document. Added foundation.color.ink, foundation.border/zIndex/breakpoint, and five new top-level groups (layout/state/interaction/responsive/platform) to close the gap against the requested 8-category framework below. Every new value is either lifted from a real, already-committed file (App.tsx's W scale, styles.css's actual media query and border widths) or explicitly marked '$description: reserved/no token' where no real implementation exists yet — nothing here is invented and left unlabeled.

tokenCategories.$description: Map of the requested 01-08 category framework onto this file's actual top-level keys. Not restructured into 8 literal top-level groups: foundation/semantic/component/screen are referenced by $value alias strings inside this same file (e.g. "{foundation.color.pink}"), so renaming or moving them would break every internal reference for no real benefit. This map gives the requested taxonomy without that risk.
tokenCategories.01_Foundation: foundation.* (color, spacing, radius, opacity, motion, type, touch, safeArea, border, zIndex, breakpoint, gestalt.*)
tokenCategories.04_Component: component.* (button, waveformPlayer) — thin today; most component-level decisions live directly in musiclinkd-system/src/App.tsx rather than here

ink.$description: Primary ACTION colour (buttons, active states) — matches --ml-black in musiclinkd-system/src/styles.css and --primary in admin/app/globals.css, both corrected 2026-08-16. Distinct from navy below: ink is a true neutral black used for CTAs, navy is the dark hero-surface colour and was never the action colour.

pink.$description: SECONDARY / brand accent — active-tab underline, focus rings, brand marks, highlights. Not the primary action colour as of the 2026-08-16 correction; see foundation.color.ink.

neutral.$description: Gestalt's gray/roboflow ramp, hue-neutral so it carries no brand meaning — safe reuse per guide/README boundaries (no purple, no competing brand palette). --line and --muted are aliased onto the closest steps for continuity.

550.$description: nearest neighbour of foundation.color.muted (#7D7D8E) is 500; 550 sits one step darker

4.$description: Section spacing, page margins, hero padding
Pill / full round (buttons, chips, avatars) — functional token, not a numeric-scale step

2.$description: Body text, default UI copy, small headings

border.$description: Grounded in actual usage: musiclinkd-system/src/styles.css uses exactly two widths, both against --color-border-container.

hairline.$description: Default: card outlines, dividers, list separators

emphasis.$description: Active-tab underline (.ml-tab-btn.active) — the one place a heavier border is actually used

zIndex.$description: Only 'sticky' is wired into real CSS today (styles.css .ml-nav, z-index:5). The rest is a reserved, standard layering scale declared now so future overlay/modal/toast work doesn't invent ad-hoc numbers — none of those three exist as built components yet, so treat them as reserved, not verified.

overlay.$description: Reserved — no overlay component built yet

modal.$description: Reserved — no modal component built yet

toast.$description: Reserved — no toast/snackbar component built yet

breakpoint.$description: Only mobileMax is wired into real CSS today (styles.css @media max-width:600px — the single breakpoint in the whole stylesheet). tablet/desktop are reserved for when a second breakpoint is actually needed; nothing consumes them yet.

gestalt.$description: Full-fidelity Gestalt token scales, extracted verbatim (values only — brand hues excluded, see meta.note). Additive: nothing in foundation.* above references these. Use directly for new component work that needs finer steps than the v6.0 core provides.

opacity.$description: Gestalt's real opacity ramp — diverges from foundation.opacity above (MusicLinkd's own hover/pressed/disabled/scrim choices), kept separate rather than overriding shipped interaction states.

font.$description: Fixed-step scale, for reference only — MusicLinkd's foundation.type uses fluid clamp() by deliberate choice (see frontend/guide/README.md) and is not being replaced by this fixed scale.

elevation.darkMode: none — Gestalt drops shadows in dark mode in favor of a 1px border; see comp-web-color-dark border tokens if MusicLinkd adds dark mode.

semantic.$description: Gestalt's real component motion recipes (duration + easing pairs). Reference for expanding MusicLinkd's motion language beyond the current single curveStandard.

action.$description: The primary-action colour ramp. Mirrors musiclinkd-system/src/styles.css and admin/app/globals.css exactly (both corrected 2026-08-16: primary action is black, not pink). This group did not exist before this pass — component.button.primary.background was pointing at semantic.text.brand (pink), which is the bug those two CSS files already fixed at the stylesheet level but tokens.json never caught up to. Fixed here.

primaryPressed.$description: #2B2B2B — lifts off pure black so the pressed state is visible

primaryWeak.$description: Disabled / weak wash — grey, not a tinted black

accent.$description: Brand marks, icon accents only — not the CTA

dark.$description: data-theme="dark" override. A black primary on a near-black surface is invisible, so dark mode inverts to the light tone with dark text — same logic as admin/app/globals.css .dark block. The accent does NOT invert (see styles.css comment, 2026-08-16).

brand.$description: Brand-coloured TEXT (labels, links) — not the button token. See semantic.action.primary for the actual CTA colour.

background.$description: Was {semantic.text.brand} (pink) — wrong since the 2026-08-16 black-primary correction. Fixed.

layout.$description: Container/grid tokens. container.* is not invented — it's the W scale already committed in musiclinkd-system/src/App.tsx (const W = {...}), lifted here so it has one source of truth instead of living only in a TS file. grid.* is the real pattern in styles.css: there is no fixed N-column grid anywhere in this codebase, only CSS auto-fill with a per-context minmax floor — documented as such rather than inventing a 12-column grid that doesn't exist.

grid.$description: No fixed-column grid exists in this codebase. These are the real auto-fill minmax floors from styles.css, each wrapped in min(Npx,100%) so a track never forces horizontal overflow on a narrow viewport.

gutter.$description: 16px — matches the gap used across all four grids above

state.$description: Interaction-state opacities and colours a component moves through. Not a new colour system — these are aliases onto foundation.opacity (already real, already used) plus semantic.action, assembled into one place per-state instead of leaving each component to reference the underlying scale directly.

default.$description: No override — component's own base tokens apply

hover.$description: 0.08 overlay, OR semantic.action.primaryHover for the primary button specifically

focus.$description: Focus ring colour — matches admin/app/globals.css --ring, deliberately kept pink/accent in both themes (a black ring on black text would be invisible)

pressed.$description: 0.16, OR semantic.action.primaryPressed for the primary button specifically

loading.$description: No dedicated token — SkeletonLoaderBlock in App.tsx uses Gestalt's own shimmer, not a MusicLinkd token

interaction.$description: Hit-area and input-method tokens. hitArea aliases the pre-existing foundation.touch (not duplicated). pointer/keyboard/gesture are honestly documented as NOT having dedicated MusicLinkd tokens yet — those states currently come from Gestalt's own compiled CSS and the browser's native focus-visible behaviour, not from anything in this file.

pointer.$description: No MusicLinkd token — hover/pointer states are Gestalt's own compiled CSS

keyboard.$description: No MusicLinkd token — focus-visible relies on browser default + Gestalt; state.focus above is the one place a MusicLinkd colour choice is layered on top (the pink ring)

gesture.$description: No MusicLinkd token — SwipeDeckBlock's drag threshold is a hardcoded value in App.tsx, not tokenized

dismissal.$description: 200ms — matches the hover-lift duration used elsewhere; no separate dismissal-specific duration exists

responsive.$description: Alias layer onto foundation.breakpoint. See that group's own note: only mobileMax is actually consumed by CSS today.

density.$description: No density token — this is a single-density web guide, not a native app with device-density variants. Listed here because the requested 8-category framework calls for it, not because it's implemented.

platform.$description: Where app (native mobile, not yet built) and web (this guide, live) genuinely differ. Written from what's real: the guide/admin/webapp surfaces in THIS repo are web-only. foundation.touch/safeArea/haptic exist because Widget_Directory.md and screen.json spec a future native app — they are forward-declared for that, not consumed by any web CSS today.

web.hover: available — Gestalt's own hover states apply
web.safeArea: not applicable — no notch/home-indicator inset on web

app.hover: not applicable — no persistent hover on touch

consumesTokensFrom.$description: Nothing yet — no native app exists in this repo. foundation.touch/safeArea/semantic.haptic are reserved for it.
